findings.detail: A real forward/backward check could not be run in this environment: importing the trainer fails immediately because PyTorch is unavailable (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'). The stability feature itself is intentionally export-only and uses no trainable parameters; static inspection therefore cannot establish the requested finite-loss/gradient behavior of the actual trainer path.
findings.reproduction: Run `python -c 'import torch'` in the current environment; it raises ModuleNotFoundError. The attempted synthetic RQVAE forward/backward check fails at `from train_rqvae import ...` for the same reason.
findings.correction: Run the real synthetic forward/backward and a short trainer smoke test in the project's configured PyTorch environment, confirming finite loss/gradients and nonzero gradients on the intended baseline encoder/codebook parameters. No code correction is identified from this environment-only blocker.
